# Onity

> Onity (`com.onity.framework`) is one Unity package for dependency injection, reactive state, typed messaging, factories and pooling, and `OnityTask` async, with one lifetime model: a scope owns its services, subscriptions, tasks and pools and disposes them together. The core is engine-free and unit-testable, and the package replaces Zenject or VContainer, R3 or UniRx, MessagePipe and UniTask in a Unity 2022.3 project. Read the AI usage guide first, then only the feature guide the task needs. The package source and its tests are the authority when a document disagrees with the code.

All paths are relative to this file, the package root. `Documentation~/` is generated from the repository's `docs/` folder and is ignored by Unity, so it is plain Markdown on disk.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI coding agents, and how to install the `onity-use` skill into a project.
- [AI usage guide](Documentation~/AI/Onity-AI-Usage-Guide.md): the rules, the canonical scene, a per-module API index and the error-to-fix tables, verified against the source.
- [Getting started](Documentation~/Getting-Started.md): install Onity and build one scene step by step with dependency injection, reactive state, a typed message, an async loop on the scope token, a pooled prefab and a scene-free test.
- [onity-use skill](Documentation~/AI/skills/onity-use/SKILL.md): agent skill for code that consumes Onity; copied into a project by `Onity/AI/Install Assistant Guidance...`.

## Guides

- [Guides index](Documentation~/guide/index.md): the guides in reading order.
- [Dependency injection](Documentation~/guide/dependency-injection.md): `OnityContainer`, bindings and lifetimes, identified and conditional bindings, collection injection, injection sites, build and async startup, the composition helpers.
- [Lifecycle and scopes](Documentation~/guide/lifecycle-and-scopes.md): the one lifetime model, lifetimes, the scope token, disposal order, the lifecycle interfaces and the Unity contexts.
- [Reactive](Documentation~/guide/reactive.md): `IOnityObservable<T>`, `Subject<T>`, `ReactiveProperty<T>`, operators, Unity frame loops, subscription lifetime and the `OnityTask` bridges.
- [Events and messaging](Documentation~/guide/events-messaging.md): typed pub/sub with the broker, `OnityEventHub`, `OnityEvent`, keyed and async channels, messages as streams and `OnityTask` receives with backpressure.
- [Async with OnityTask](Documentation~/guide/onitytask.md): frame waits and PlayerLoop timings, timed waits and timers, composition, triggers and UI events, async streams and channels, scope lifetimes, Unity operations, and the reactive and messaging bridges.
- [Factories and pooling](Documentation~/guide/factories-and-pooling.md): `IFactory` and `BindFactory`, `BindPooledFactory`, prefab and plain pools, pool lifetime and the parameterized spawn forms.
- [Performance and IL2CPP](Documentation~/guide/performance-and-il2cpp.md): activation paths, the hot-path design, what the measured comparisons show with their conditions, the known slower cases and the IL2CPP checklist.
- [Refactoring from existing architecture](Documentation~/guide/refactoring-from-existing-architecture.md): moving singleton managers, static events, coroutine loops and VContainer or Zenject setups to injected services and thin MonoBehaviours.
- [OnityTask vs UniTask](Documentation~/guide/onitytask-comparison.md): the 2026-10-02 Release Player gate, API coverage and the remaining gaps.

## Reference

- [Reference index](Documentation~/reference/index.md): the catalogs for each pillar.
- [DI API](Documentation~/reference/di-api.md): the `OnityContainer` surface, scope lifetime members, injection sites, composition helpers, factories and exceptions.
- [Reactive operators](Documentation~/reference/reactive-operators.md): every operator, factory, subscribe overload, lifetime helper, Unity frame source, provider and `OnityTask` bridge.
- [Messaging API](Documentation~/reference/messaging-api.md): broker and channels, keyed and async channels, `OnityEvent`, `OnityEventHub`, the bridges and the `OnityTask` consumers.

## Migration

- [Migration index](Documentation~/Migration/index.md): the method for moving an existing project onto Onity.
- [From Zenject](Documentation~/Migration/From-Zenject.md): Zenject and Extenject binding, injection, lifecycle and signal mappings, and what ships.
- [From VContainer](Documentation~/Migration/From-VContainer.md): VContainer registration, lifetimes, entry points and factories.
- [From R3 and UniRx](Documentation~/Migration/From-R3.md): reactive primitives, operators, subscription lifetime and what is not shipped.
- [From UniTask](Documentation~/Migration/From-UniTask.md): UniTask 2.5.11 names mapped to `OnityTask`, behavior differences, assembly references and the upgrade notes from Onity 0.5.
